brand.name: Datchord
brand.footer: A warm home for small communities with big hearts.

auth.heroTitle: Find your people. Keep the conversation going.
auth.heroSubtitle: Datchord is a warm, focused home for the communities you care about — with room for every voice.
auth.previewMessage: Tiny experiment: the warmer palette feels friendlier, but I worry it fights the illustrations.
auth.previewReply: What if the illustrations drop to a single accent so the orange can lead?
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
auth.registerSubtitle: Create an account and start your first community.
auth.usernameHint: 3–24 characters. Letters, numbers, dots, and underscores.
auth.termsNote: By continuing, you agree to keep this a kind place.

home.title: Your community, your rhythm.
home.subtitle: Create a server for your people or join one with an invite code.
home.createBody: A home for a club, a team, or a group chat that grew up.
home.joinBody: Already have an invite? Step inside.
home.tipBody: You'll be the owner of any server you create — with room to bring on moderators later.
home.noChannelsBody: Create a channel to give the conversation a place to land.

servers.createSubtitle: Give your community a name, a face, and a little personality.
servers.name: Server name
servers.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this place for? Keep it short and warm.
servers.pictureHint: PNG, JPG, or WebP. Up to 2 MB.
servers.joinSubtitle: Enter the invite code you were given.
servers.emptyBody: Create your first server or join one with an invite code.
servers.inviteSubtitle: Share this code with people you'd like to welcome in.
servers.shareHint: Anyone with this code can join this server.
servers.ownerDescription: The owner has full control of this server. Ownership can only change through an explicit transfer.
servers.overviewSubtitle: Update the details people see when they arrive.
servers.inviteSectionBody: Share this code with people you want to welcome in.
servers.leaveBody: You'll need a new invite to come back. Your messages will stay in the server.
servers.deleteBody: This permanently removes every channel, message, role, and membership. This cannot be undone.
servers.deleteConfirmLabel: Type the server name to confirm
servers.transferBody: Choose a member to become the new owner. You'll stay in the server as a regular member.
servers.transferConfirmLabel: Type the server name to confirm
servers.transferWarning: This cannot be undone by you. Only the new owner can transfer it back.
servers.kickBody: They'll lose access to this server. You can invite them again later.
servers.manageRolesSubtitle: Choose which roles this member should have. The Member role is always included.
servers.noAssignableRoles: There are no roles you can assign to this member.
servers.memberPrivate: This member keeps their profile details private.
servers.channelCreateSubtitle: Give the conversation a name and a little direction.
servers.channelEditSubtitle: Update the channel name or topic.
servers.channelNameHint: Lowercase works best. Spaces become hyphens.
servers.channelDeleteBody: All messages in this channel will be permanently removed.
servers.channelsSubtitle: Shape the rooms your community gathers in.
servers.channelsEmpty: No channels yet. Create the first one.
servers.rolesSubtitle: Roles lower in the list can be managed by roles above them.
servers.roleCreateSubtitle: Give this role a name, a color, and the powers it needs.
servers.roleEditSubtitle: Adjust this role's identity and permissions.
servers.rolePermissionsHint: You can only grant permissions you already have.
servers.roleHierarchyNote: Higher roles can manage lower roles. The server owner is always above every role.
servers.roleDefaultNote: This is the default role every member has. It can't be deleted or moved, but its permissions can be adjusted.
servers.roleDeleteBody: Anyone with this role will lose it. This cannot be undone.
servers.roleCannotGrant: You don't have permission to grant this.
servers.roleGrantWarning: This role can manage other roles and members. Only grant it to people you trust.
servers.roleOwnerNote: The owner always has every permission and cannot be removed from this role.
servers.membersSubtitle: See who's here, what they can do, and keep the community healthy.
servers.ownerProtection: The owner can't be removed or given a different role.
servers.dangerSubtitle: High-impact actions live here. Take your time.
servers.deleteServerDescription: Permanently remove this server and all of its data.
servers.transferOwnershipDescription: Make another member the owner. This can't be undone by you.
servers.leaveDescription: Leave this server and remove it from your list.
servers.permissionDeniedBody: You don't have permission to manage this part of the server. Ask the owner or an administrator if you need access.
servers.noManageableServersBody: Servers you can manage will appear here.
servers.serverNotFound: That server could not be found.
servers.invalidImage: That image could not be used. Try another one.
servers.removedToast: You no longer have access to that server.
servers.rotateInviteHint: Old invite links stop working as soon as you generate a new code.
servers.rotateInviteBody: Everyone with the old code will not be able to join using it. Current members stay in the server.
servers.nicknameSubtitle: Nicknames are only used inside this server.
servers.nicknameHint: Leave it empty to use their normal display name.
servers.roleAdminWarning: Administrator grants every permission, including future ones. Give it only to people you fully trust.

roles.manageServerDesc: Edit server details, invite settings, and the server picture.
roles.manageRolesDesc: Create, edit, assign, and remove roles below this one.
roles.manageMessagesDesc: Delete messages written by other members.
roles.defaultDescription: The baseline role every member has.
roles.ownerDesc: Full control of the server, always.
roles.administratorDesc: Grants every permission and bypasses role limits.
roles.manageInvitesDesc: Generate new invite codes and control who can join.
roles.manageNicknamesDesc: Change the nicknames of other members.
roles.changeNicknameDesc: Set a nickname for yourself in this server.
roles.mentionEveryoneDesc: Use @everyone and @here to notify the whole server.

chat.welcomeBody: This is the start of the channel. Say hello, share a link, or ask the question you've been sitting on.
chat.emptyBody: No messages yet. Be the first to start the conversation.
chat.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
chat.deleteBody: This message will disappear for everyone in the channel.
chat.channelNotFoundBody: Pick another channel from the list to keep chatting.
chat.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.messageTooLong: Messages can be up to {{max}} characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Datchord feel like yours.
settings.serverSettingsDescription: Manage servers you own or help run
settings.accountSubtitle: Manage the details that keep your account secure.
settings.emailHint: Only you can see this email.
settings.passwordSubtitle: Use at least 8 characters. Changing your password signs out other devices.
settings.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Other devices have been signed out.
settings.signOutDescription: You'll need your email and password to sign back in.
settings.dangerDescription: This permanently deletes your account, messages, and memberships. You must transfer or delete any servers you own first.
settings.deleteAccountWarning: This cannot be undone. Type your password to confirm.
settings.profileSubtitle: This is how you show up across Datchord.
settings.avatarDescription: A square image works best. PNG, JPG, or WebP up to 2 MB.
settings.removeAvatarBody: Your default avatar will appear instead.
settings.displayNameHint: This is the name people see most often.
settings.usernameHint: Your unique handle. Letters, numbers, dots, and underscores.
settings.bioHint: A sentence or two about what you're into. Up to 190 characters.
settings.bioPlaceholder: What are you making, learning, or thinking about?
settings.privacySubtitle: You decide how much of your profile other members can see.
settings.showBioDescription: Other members can see your bio when they open your profile.
settings.showMemberSinceDescription: Other members can see how long you've been part of a server.
settings.privacyNote: Your email address is always private, no matter these settings.
settings.notificationsSubtitle: Choose when Datchord should tap you on the shoulder.
settings.notifyAllDescription: Get a notification for every message in the channel you're viewing.
settings.notifyMentionsDescription: Only notify me when someone writes @{{username}}.
settings.notifyNoneDescription: Keep the room quiet. You can always check back in.
settings.soundDescription: Play a soft chime when a new message arrives.
settings.desktopDescription: Show a browser notification when Datchord is in the background.
settings.desktopBlocked: Your browser is blocking notifications. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.
settings.browserUnsupported: This browser doesn't support desktop notifications.
settings.notificationTestBody: This is how a new message will look.
settings.appearanceSubtitle: Set the mood. Changes apply right away and follow you across devices.
settings.previewMessage: This is how the conversation will feel.
settings.languageSubtitle: Choose the language you'd like Datchord to use. Dates, times, numbers, and plurals follow along.
settings.rtlNote: Arabic uses a right-to-left layout. The whole interface mirrors automatically.
settings.missingFallback: If a translation is missing, Datchord falls back to English rather than showing a missing label.
settings.languageNames: Names are shown in their own language.
settings.serverSettingsSubtitle: Open the settings for servers where you have management permissions.
settings.noManageableServersBody: When you create a server or receive a management role, it will appear here.

image.requirements: PNG, JPG, or WebP · up to 2 MB
image.removeBody: The default gradient will be used instead.
image.uploadError: We couldn't save that picture. Please try again.
image.invalidType: That file type isn't supported. Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: That image is too large. Choose one under 2 MB.
image.readError: We couldn't read that file. Try another image.
image.previewNote: This is how it will look. Nothing is saved until you choose Save picture.

status.offline: You're offline. Some actions may not work until you reconnect.
status.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. Your data is safe.
status.serverLoadErrorBody: It may have been removed, or your connection may be offline.
status.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.SERVER_NOT_FOUND: That server could not be found, or you're no longer a member.
errors.CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND: That channel could not be found.
errors.MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND: That message could not be found.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That member could not be found.
errors.ROLE_NOT_FOUND: That role could not be found.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: That email is already in use.
errors.INVALID_USERNAME: Usernames need 3–24 letters, numbers, dots, or underscores.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Please check the form and try again.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: That image could not be read. Try another one.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE_TYPE: Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: That image is too large. Choose one under 2 MB.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.INVALID_INVITE: That invite code doesn't match a server.
errors.CHANNEL_EXISTS: A channel with that name already exists.
errors.ROLE_EXISTS: A role with that name already exists.
errors.INVALID_CHANNEL_NAME: Use letters, numbers, or hyphens for the channel name.
errors.LAST_CHANNEL: A server needs at least one channel.
errors.OWNER_PROTECTED: The server owner can't be changed this way.
errors.OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: Transfer ownership or delete the server instead of leaving.
errors.ROLE_HIERARCHY: You can only manage roles below your highest role.
errors.PERMISSION_GRANT: You can't grant permissions you don't have.
errors.DEFAULT_ROLE_PROTECTED: The default Member role can't be deleted or moved.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The name didn't match. Try again.
errors.SELF_ROLE_CHANGE: You can't change your own roles.
errors.OWNS_SERVERS: Transfer or delete the servers you own before deleting your account.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: This request came from an unexpected place. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_CONTENT_TYPE: That request wasn't in a supported format.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The request could not be read. Refresh and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_CHANNEL_TOPIC: That channel topic is too long.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: That person could not be found.
errors.CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND: That conversation could not be found, or you're no longer part of it.
errors.GROUP_TOO_SMALL: Private groups need at least two other people.
errors.GROUP_TOO_LARGE: That group has too many people.
errors.MENTION_EVERYONE: You don't have permission to mention everyone.

validation.username: Use 3–24 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, or underscores.
validation.bioMax: Keep your bio to 190 characters or fewer.
validation.serverDescription: Keep the description to 200 characters or fewer.
validation.channelTopic: Keep the topic to 120 characters or fewer.
validation.messageTooLong: Messages can be up to {{max}} characters.
validation.imageType: Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image.

dms.title: Messages
dms.subtitle: Private conversations
dms.newSubtitle: Talk privately with one person or bring a few people together.
dms.directHint: Only the two of you can read this conversation.
dms.groupHint: Choose at least two people to start a private group.
dms.pickTwo: Choose at least two people for a group.
dms.emptyBody: Start a quiet conversation with someone.
dms.emptyPanelBody: Pick a conversation or start a new one.
dms.ownerOnly: Only the group owner can rename it or manage members.
dms.removeBody: They will lose access to this private conversation.
dms.leaveBody: You will no longer receive its messages. You can be added again later.
dms.welcomeDirect: This is the beginning of your conversation with {{name}}.
dms.welcomeDirectBody: Say hello, share a thought, or plan something together.
dms.emptyConversation: Send the first message to get things started.
dms.removedToast: This conversation is no longer available.
